name: Spark Forge Azure
summary: Azure-native Spark engineering specialist: Databricks, ADLS, Synapse, Event Hubs, Fabric, ADF and Unity Catalog. Exposes its real surface (sdd.*, azure.*, fabric.*, doctor); it is not an alias of the AWS sibling.
appropriate_for: Spark on Azure: Databricks jobs, Synapse Spark pools, Fabric Spark
Azure data estate: ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs, ADF pipelines, Unity Catalog governance
inappropriate_for: AWS Spark estates â€” route to spark-forge-aws (Unity Catalog is not Lake Formation; ADF is not Glue)
API contract work â€” route to api-forge
platform engineering â€” route to platform-forge

install.command: python3.11 -m venv <azure-venv> && <azure-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <azure-python> -m pip install "sparkforge-azure>=0.1,<0.2" <the-forge>/adapters/sparkforge_azure

limitations_note: Azure-only. Consumes staged bundles (case.yaml, docs/sdd/); evidence is re-bound to staged sha256, never to self-reported hashes.
examples: check a Databricks job that fails on ADLS access
diagnose Fabric access to a lakehouse table
run the azure doctor on a Synapse Spark estate
